mapper.select: SELECT m.*, fd.name AS from_dept_name, td.name AS to_dept_name, fu.nickname AS from_user_name, tu.nickname AS to_user_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name FROM fin_asset_move m LEFT JOIN sys_dept fd ON fd.id = m.from_dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept td ON td.id = m.to_dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_user fu ON fu.id = m.from_user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user tu ON tu.id = m.to_user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.create_by WHERE m.asset_id = #{assetId} ORDER BY m.move_date DESC, m.id DESC
